verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Fly.io's private networking (e.g., internal-only IPv6 mesh or WireGuard-based service mesh) that would let internal traffic bypass the public internet without VPC setup; the closest items (fly-io-docs-11/12/13) describe credential/token management for 'Sprites' (AI agent sandboxes) rather than a service-to-service private network fabric. Missing for 10: any documentation of a private/internal networking layer, VPC-free internal routing, or independent confirmation of traffic isolation.
